body:
I happened to watch the movie at the Singapore premiere and I was glad that I did not miss it.

The movie starts with a peppy number which allows you to get into the groove however, few minutes into it, the plot starts to unfold and you know that you are in for a juicy whodunit tale which keeps you gripped until the last minute when the suspense is revealed.

Without giving any spoilers, the movie's plot revolves around the ongoing challenge that we see with teenagers/youth who, in their desire to become famous on social media, can get entangled into an undesired situation (murder in this case) and face extreme consequences.

Abhishek Merukar's work shines as a debut film maker. He is able to keep a good balance of humor and drama while keeping with the central theme of suspense throughout the movie. I read in his interview that he is aware that the Marathi movie audience is intelligent and wanted to serve them with an entertaining story that respects this fact. I would dare to say that this is a very noble thought not just for Marathi movie audiences but also for Indian cinema as a whole. I wish more filmmakers will think this way and only then we will have movies that can compete and stand at the same level with world cinema.

The casting of the movie is spot on. Amey Wagh is completely in the character of an Insurance agent who while keeping his clients interests, also looks at his own interests. Amruta Khanavilkar brings a mature take in her character of a social / NGO activist and also brings the star value the movie deserves. Jui Bhagwat has got a perfect debut as a lead actor and handles the various situations and expressions that her character requires very well. The supporting cast Rajasi Bhave, Srikant Yadav, Pushkaraj Chirputkar, Vitthal Kale, and Shubhankar Tawde lend their performance ably to keep the plot suspense on point.

All in all, this is a movie that every Marathi movie audience should watch and support so that more and more filmmakers can bring the stories that we deserve. Being a suspense drama, it goes without saying that it should be enjoyed on the big screen.

Cheers to an intelligent audience!

Abhishek Merukar has made a fabulous movie which everyone should definitely watch with their family!

I watched the world premier of the film in Singapore and really liked every minute of it. To start with, the plot was very intriguing. The non linear narrative, especially, how different stories came together eventually was also superb. The way the characters are established gradually was also commendable. Special mention of the humour sprinkled here and there which enhanced the flavour of everything. Camerawork was excellent and so was the attention to detail in art direction. The ending was especially impactful - a great feat which very few suspense movies pull off. Everything turned on its head - making me feel I am watching some masterful Korean movie!!

All in all, it's a rare and innovative movie you must go and watch in the theatres now!

I only watch movies that have a rating of 6+ on IMDB, and I never usually review movies on IMDB. However, this is probably my first review on the platform, and I'm writing it because Like and Subscribe truly deserves appreciation. This Marathi movie is a rare gem that combines suspense with light-hearted humor, making it a unique and engaging watch. Unlike typical suspense thrillers that rely on horror or dark themes, this film keeps you on the edge of your seat while also sprinkling in moments of laughter that feel natural and refreshing.

The storytelling is crisp and keeps you hooked from start to finish. The plot unfolds in a way that keeps you guessing, and just when you think you've figured it out, it surprises you with another twist. What stands out the most is the brilliant acting by the entire cast. Each character is well-written and portrayed with such authenticity that you feel connected to them throughout the movie. The performances are so convincing that you forget you're watching a film and get completely immersed in the story.

The cinematography and background score further elevate the experience, creating an atmosphere that complements the mood of the film perfectly.

What I loved most about Like and Subscribe is its ability to keep you entertained without relying on unnecessary drama or over-the-top elements. It's a clean, well-crafted film that respects the audience's intelligence and delivers a satisfying cinematic experience. Whether you're a fan of suspense, comedy, or just good storytelling, this movie has something for everyone.

In a world where most films either focus on heavy drama or mindless entertainment, Like and Subscribe stands out as a breath of fresh air. It's a must-watch for anyone who appreciates quality cinema.

I highly recommend it and hope more people discover this underrated masterpiece.

After reading the title of this movie, I thought it must be a cringe movie about a GenZ influencer. But I was wrong. Amruta Khanvilkar and Ameya Wagh acted very well in this one. The girl playing the influencer is not that good in acting. It's a murder mystery. How the influencer gets stuck in it and how the character of Amruta Khanvilkar tries to help her is shown in this one. Some part of it is predictable. Still I would consider it a good attempt. The twist in the story is good. They kept the curiosity alive till the end by giving good story build up. They should have come up with better name though.

**Movie Review**

I went into this thriller with fairly low expectations, but I came out genuinely surprised and impressed. This film is proof that a clean, gripping movie can deliver edge-of-your-seat entertainment without resorting to excessive violence or unnecessary elements.

From start to finish, it was a fast-paced ride, packed with twists and turns that kept me hooked throughout. Not a single moment felt dragged or boring. The narrative flowed seamlessly, building suspense in a way that was smart yet easy to follow. What truly stood out was how the movie struck a perfect balance between thrill and accessibility, making it suitable for a family watch.

The performances were strong, the direction sharp, and the cinematography added to the tension without being overwhelming. It's rare to find a thriller that feels fresh and engaging while still being clean and universally enjoyable, but this one nailed it.

If you're looking for a high-energy, suspenseful movie that you can enjoy with the entire family without worrying about over-the-top violence, this is a must-watch.
